Transport Refrigeration Specialists
We offer bespoke service packages to suit the needs of your business. Maintaining your refrigerated transportation is the ideal way to avoid interruptions to your products and services. We maintain and service refrigerators to enable them to perform at the best of their ability and keep your business flowing with minimal interruption.
We understand the 24 hour business of logistics that mean unforeseen problems. We operate a 24 hour call out system to respond to the urgent needs of your business. We are accurate with call out times and aim to where possible, have you back on the road as quick as possible.
We operate a robust installation provision that aims to meet the needs of the customer and install your requested product within realistic timescales. As a Frigoblock agent, we are among the leading installers of the product within the East Midlands with highly trained engineers.
CC Refrigeration Ltd has been a trusted provider of transport refrigeration services for over 20 years. Our highly experienced and qualified engineers take pride in delivering an honest and quality service to our customers. As an organisation we are keen to meet the needs of our customers and fully understand the demands and limitations of the logistics industry. We work in an industry where there is constant change and evolution, which we embrace and move the development of the business to cater for ongoing innovation.
